summary: Real-VM legal jdk_systemd round trip on the live candidate. The harness runner was reaped by a session memory-pressure event mid-install (server executor kept running); the install leg was terminated in-band via the product cancel API after two 300s curl timeouts to a slow TUNA mirror; the uninstall leg ran as a legal deploy task and SUCCEEDED; shared host returned byte-exact to pre-run state.

harness.casesAtKill: d00..d06 PASS 7/7 (d00 authenticated borrow; d01 harmless marker pkg; d02 fixed nginx pkg metadata; d03 real SSH preview+exec+persisted logs; d04 wrong-fingerprint reject; d05 fixed-template injection 400; d06 pagination/events)
harness.d07Status: install task started and previewed (intentVersion returned) then runner killed
harness.killNote: background harness process reaped by low-memory event (not a harness failure); NOT restarted per system instruction

events.note: executor connected and ran the install script on the real host

installTask.rootCauseOfInstallNotSuccess: environmental: TUNA mirror throughput too low to fetch 190MB OpenJDK tar.gz within curl retry budget

executionTimeoutObservation.note: The 1500s execution timeout was not observed to terminate the running task between 11:17-11:58; an explicit cancel was required. Contrast: t02f's 20s timeout DID surface 'context deadline exceeded'. Candidate-side observation for triage, not asserted as a defect.
executionTimeoutObservation.followUp: triaged by maintainer/codex: exec-timeout should bound the whole SSH exec (incl. blocked reads), not require in-band cancel

uninstallWrongFingerprintControl.note: Both started with the BASELINE ed25519 fingerprint (SHA256:FhLFR...), which is the ssh-probe pinned known_hosts key, NOT the key the product's Go executor presents on handshake. Result: sshHostKeyMismatch before any step ran. This doubles as the d04 wrong-fingerprint negative semantics reproduced on the uninstall execution path.

hostRestoreAndCleanup.hostStateAfter: byte-exact to pre-run state (jdk.sh 60B vendr bytes; no /tmp/<runId>/jdk; no /tmp/jdk-installer; no pantheon-t02-jdk service)

nginx_systemd.decision: environmentally deferred to dedicated host (T16 fresh-install)

mysql_systemd.note: user absent, but install would init a system DB on a host already running mariadbd under nginx

redis_systemd.decision: uninstall would kill shared redis data (/data/redis)

harbor_offline.note: no userdel; uninstall does docker compose down -v + rm -rf installRoot; install is heavy docker compose on shared host

jdk_systemd.decision: only environmentally safe template (no userdel, task-owned /tmp root); legal round trip executed

governance: all worktree changes UNCOMMITTED; no commit/push/release; maintenance sign-off pending (maintainer three-touchpoint gate)
